title: Complete logical assessment
solution:
const item = { price: 2000, category: "electronics", isMember: true, couponCode: "SAVE10" }
const basePrice = item.price
const memberDiscount = item.isMember ? basePrice * 0.1 : 0
const categoryDiscount = item.category === "electronics" ? (basePrice - memberDiscount) * 0.05 : 0
const couponDiscount = item.couponCode === "SAVE10" ? (basePrice - memberDiscount - categoryDiscount) * 0.1 : 0
const finalPrice = basePrice - memberDiscount - categoryDiscount - couponDiscount
return { basePrice, memberDiscount, categoryDiscount, couponDiscount, finalPrice }
